proposals.rule: Crypto lot method check: when an exchange export says it uses FIFO, no lot sold on a given date should be newer than a lot of the same asset that is still held.
proposals.firesWhen: The export says it uses FIFO, and a lot was sold while an older lot of the same asset, bought before that sale, is still held.
proposals.silentWhen: The export says it uses specific identification, or every lot still held was bought after each sale of that asset.
